title: Too expensive
text: Too expensive. Is thin walled so pumps easily in commode, but you have to pump more often to loosen blockage vs heavier plunger head. Point being dont think 1 or 2 pushes will do the job and water level keeps getting higher. Also practice (no kidding) getting it out of holder. When water filling quickly and grabbing this tool finds the base keeps being stuck, you will have to pull it off while bowl overflows. Not for use on tub drain. Doesnt allow any pressure seal to form. (so I've kept older/heavier plunger I wanted to toss. Kept turning inside out and too hard/messy trying to reverse it using the commode lip). Pretty, though and the heads are replaceable. Even though drips are containted, I wonder if dosing it with Lysol periodically (yuck/odor) weakens rubber? When using it will allow for splashes (result of needing effort to force out blockage). You will have to decide on force, or multiple pumps to do the job (For me it is multiple, faster pumping to release blockage. Too small a 'footprint' to be super effective). I wont bother returning it. Well made (material and construction).
